title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E5 — Grandpa Campbell
When Ray's ne'er-do-well father comes for a visit, he turns the household upside-down -- and turns Tamera into a ruthless businesswoman!

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E6 — Twins Get Fired
When Tia becomes Tamera's new boss at Rocket Burger, they both learn a lesson in responsibility.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E4 — Mis-Directed Study
Moesha is flying high after she gets a job tutoring one of the basketball team’s star players until she finds out what kind of game he really wants to play.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E5 — Not My Pumpkin
Things get tense at the Mitchell house when Frank discovers Moesha has been taking birth control pills – and he’s the last to know.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E6 — Just Above My Head
Moesha finds her history teacher’s remarks racially offensive, but fears that confronting him might affect her grade and cost Niecy her scholarship.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E7 — A Den Is A Terrible Thing To Waste
A well-intentioned Moesha intervenes to try and stop her once-popular hangout, The Den, from being sold to a commercial developer, unaware that Andell stands to make a great deal of money on its sale.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E8 — Isn’t She Lovely?
Hakeem and Moesha’s friendship takes an interesting turn after he surprises her with an expensive necklace to wear to a homecoming dance she’s attending with someone else.

S2 E1 — The Handwriting On The Wall
Mary, Rose and Pearl may be sent 'up the river' after they go overboard defending '227' against a graffiti artist who then sues them for assault--and it seems even bleaker when the key to their defense is the testimony of a lone eyewitness--Sandra.

S2 E2 — Fourth Time Around
Mary and Rose help Pearl face the loneliness of old age by escorting her to a single's bar where she meets the man of her dreams--and promptly gets engaged.

S2 E3 — Pillow Talk
When Mary reluctantly agrees to partner with Sandra in the pillow-making business, she finds herself doing all the work--with Sandra reaping all the 'benefits.'.

S2 E4 — Mary Nightingale
Lester turns into a real pain for Mary when he comes home from work early complaining of a stomach ache, but when she sneaks out for a pedicure, Lester is stricken with appendicitis--leaving Sandra to care for him.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E1
An aspiring radio sports announcer, Malcolm, and his talkative, would-be tow truck driver roommate, Eddie, attend a get-rich-quick seminar in hopes of winning a much-needed TV.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E2 — Eddie By Moonlight
Eddie needs another job to get his prized tow truck repaired.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E3 — On The Radio
A chance to fill in on an all-night music show has Malcolm exhausted.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E4 — Partnership Of Fools
Malcolm and Eddie use their lottery winnings to buy their building from Kelly.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E5 — Someday My TAFKAP Will Come
Eddie arranges for the Artist Formerly Known as Prince to appear at Kelly's re-opening party.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E1 — Crossed Swords
Lamont discovers that the porcelain figure he has bought is worth a great deal of money and decides auctioning off the piece will bring the best price. Fred's actions as a shill backfire, shattering Lamont's chance for freedom...and the statue.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E2 — Happy Birthday, Pop
Fred's 65th birthday is anything but happy when his first Social Security check and Lamont's 'night on the town' don't meet his expectations.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E3 — Here Comes The Bride There Goes The Bride
Fred's protest against Lamont's impending marriage fails to change his son's mind. But as the ceremony begins, the bride-to-be changes her mind, leaving Lamont standing at the altar and haggling with his relatives over their wedding gifts.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E4 — The Copper Caper
Fred's suspicions about a used-copper salesman are ignored by Lamont, especially after his son checks the metal's going price. But unfortunately for everyone, Fred's instincts prove to be correct. The copper Lamont bought was stolen.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E5 — A Matter Of Life And Breath
Lamont and Fred, at Lamont's insistence, take advantage of the free tests offered by a Breathmobile. The results convince Fred that he has tuberculosis.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E6 — We Were Robbed
Fred covers his clumsiness by proclaiming 'we were robbed' and he turns into a boastful hero cited for bravery. But Lamont finds the shattered remains of his prized porcelain and glass collection and decides to teach his father a lesson.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E1 — Grand Opening, The-part 1
George's boasting of how well he is doing heads him for a disaster when the underworld gets into the act, in Part I of a two-part story.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E3 — Once A Friend
George is seeing an old navy buddy, but is it a man or a woman? Louise is suspicious and George is confused.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E4 — George's Help
George jumps at the chance of getting a street kid to work for him at half price, but finds it's costing him more than he bargained for.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E5 — George's Legacy
If Napoleon and Lincoln could do it, so can George Jefferson -- at least that's what George believes.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E6 — Good News, Bad News
An introduction to a friend puts Helen and Louise's friendship on the line -- and George couldn't be happier.
